release_notes: The installer is 88% smaller (58 MB) — CUDA is no longer bundled. GPU acceleration still works out of the box via Vulkan (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel); NVIDIA users can add the optional CUDA pack from Settings > Behavior for maximum speed, and upgrades keep your existing CUDA files automatically. Fixed: a dictation could fail right after the app sat idle (the model-unload race), and volume ducking errored on nearly every recording. Auto-paste now tells you when it couldn't paste and why (e.g. apps running as administrator). New opt-ins: show the recording pill near the text cursor, and restore your previous clipboard after auto-paste.
